friendly_name: troupe configuration: anchors and aliases stay honest
purpose_context: Step 6 (bug bakeoff-specs-speckitty-qht) adds the Aliases contract section. Theatre owners share settings between agents with YAML anchors and aliases. Changing the anchored value must change it everywhere, while changing a value reached through an alias must be refused unless the owner asks for that alias to be expanded into its own copy.
purpose_tldr: Setting a value reached through a YAML alias is refused instead of silently changing every agent that shares the anchor; an explicit flag expands the alias so the value can be overridden.
